position: NO - do not run tonight as specified. Three load-bearing premises are false in source, all cheap to fix: (1) remaining_a=2 is a SILENT NO-OP - ScenarioE never reads base.a_total, five sites hardcode k+4 (verified: base.a_total=7 while task_text() renders '7 segments'), and no env-key whitelist exists for freightroute_evidence, so a missed amendment yields a clean-looking 2x2 where C*(0.5)=$600, the $1,800 fee needs p>=1.5, verification is DOMINATED - the exact condition PARTIAL_02 rejects - with a drop that MIMICS THE HYPOTHESIS; (2) MONEY IS NOT IN THE OBJECTIVE FUNCTION (task_text states only the HARD RULE and 'PREFERENCE: earliest ETA'; dollars are narration), so C*=$3,600p is correct algebra over a utility the subject was never given, and a costly-arm null means 'money isn't an objective', not 'checking survives cost'; (3) the dissent is an ARGUMENT, reproducing the confound the exp012 skeptic ruled unfixable by n (A6.5 makes votes-without-rationales a REQUIREMENT), and its veracity FLIPS SIGN across the cost factor, so the pooled dissenter effect averages two constructs. Also: V4 clause 2 is anti-correlated with the construct and violates hard requirement R6 - if the answer is 'yes, it still checks', V-FIRST=1.0 everywhere, V4 fails, and the run is unreportable, so the design structurally cannot deliver the affirmative answer to its own question. V1 cannot fail; MC-D2 reads the same under success and failure; MC-C2 has no written regex and sits inside the autoregressive path to the action; the MC-C3 probe's PASS fires on noise 41% of the time while its FAIL fires 59% when real sensitivity exists. The EV algebra, the $8,000 refutation, the move to action-level V-FIRST, seed matching, the prohibition list and the budget/clock arithmetic all survived - the token estimate is conservative by ~2x. BETTER WITHIN SCOPE: keep the 2x2 but move the cost channel from money to ROUNDS against a stated deadline (inspect_rounds=2, show_deadline=True, post_budget=6) - it binds on the ETA preference the subject actually has, drops E1 entirely, and is already implemented and passing in tests/test_exp013.py.
